findings.issue: No test script, no test runner, and zero test files anywhere in app/; all behavioural safety is delegated to the external acceptance suite.
findings.suggestion: Add vitest (or Playwright component tests) with a `test` script, and cover lib/format.ts and lib/data.ts first.

findings.issue: cardsForPokemon silently maps pokemon refs to species, drops IDs > 10000 and unknown IDs, and dedupes via a Map; wrong output would be indistinguishable from right without tests.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test against a fixture API: deoxys-normal → species 'deoxys', Mega form excluded, duplicate refs deduped, output sorted by dex number.

findings.issue: getSpeciesIndex builds the filter index by cross-joining type and generation records; a species absent from every type record gets types: [] and generation: undefined and vanishes from filtered views — exactly the 'extra Pokémon' overlay scenario.
findings.suggestion: Test that a species present in pokemon-species but missing from type/generation records still appears on /, and that NaN ids from idFromUrl are excluded.

findings.issue: The moves aggregation (composite dedup key, method rank order, level-then-name sort, default game = highest order) is intricate and untested; an ordering or dedup regression would silently produce wrong tables.
findings.suggestion: Extract getMoves into lib/ and unit-test: method order Level Up/Machine/Egg/Tutor/others-alphabetical, per-level level-up rows kept, level sort ascending, ?game= override and invalid ?game falling back to highest order.

findings.issue: Column sorting logic (missing values last in both directions, numeric vs localeCompare, ascending/descending flip, aria-sort on exactly one header) is untested.
findings.suggestion: Render the component in a jsdom test and assert row order and aria-sort after simulated clicks, including a column with null power.

findings.issue: Hand-rolled debounce plus the sentQuery ref race guard (preventing a slow navigation from clobbering typed text) is the most fragile client code in the app and has no coverage.
findings.suggestion: Test with a mocked router: typing does not push history but replaces after the debounce; selecting a type resets page and pushes; an in-flight navigation does not overwrite newer input.

findings.issue: The in-memory promise cache's eviction sweep can delete fresh entries once over MAX_ENTRIES, and failed requests are evicted via a value-identity check; both behaviours are easy to break in a refactor.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test TTL expiry, 404 → NotFoundError (and cache eviction of the failed promise), and the absolute-URL passthrough used for evolution_chain URLs.

findings.issue: Pagination clamping (NaN, <1, >totalPages) and the 'omit page=1 and empty filters' URL rule are untested edge behaviour.
findings.suggestion: Test ?page=abc, ?page=0, ?page=99999 and that Previous/Next hrefs keep q/type/generation while dropping default page.

findings.issue: Pure helpers (humanize, dexNumber's 4-digit padding, lastEnglish via findLast, collapseWhitespace handling \f, idFromUrl) are the cheapest regression net available and have none.
findings.suggestion: A ~30-line unit test file covering these helpers would catch most future formatting regressions.

findings.issue: Stat total row, MAX_STAT bar scaling, height/weight one-decimal formatting, hidden-ability '(hidden)' text and the recursive branching EvolutionTree are all untested presentation rules.
findings.suggestion: One or two snapshot-free render tests (assert text and roles) for a branching chain (Eevee) and a hidden ability would pin the spec's display rules.

summary: The app ships with zero tests of its own: no test script, no runner, no test files. All of its safety net comes from the externally-provided acceptance suite, which only exercises happy paths, leaving the riskiest logic — species mapping, the filter index build, the moves aggregation, URL/filter state and the fetch cache — completely unguarded against refactoring. A day of work with vitest over lib/format.ts, lib/data.ts and the two client components would convert this from 'passes today' to 'safe to change'.
